montanus-lucius.from: This work was written by Montanus and Lucius (Carthage) (fl. c. 170) to Christian brethren addressed as dearest brothers including future brothers.
montanus-lucius.to: Montanus, Lucius and their fellow prisoners wrote this in prison at Carthage about 259, to fellow Christians they call dearest brothers, including brothers still to come.

conon-gardener.from: This martyrdom account was written by Acts of the Martyrs (c. 165) and it names no addressee.
conon-gardener.to: The writer of this martyrdom account is unknown, and it names no addressee.

marianus-james.from: The writer listed here as Acts of the Martyrs (c. 165) was the anonymous intimate companion of the martyrs,
marianus-james.to: The writer, who does not give his name, was a close companion of the martyrs,
